function.name: sports_ranking_get_top_ranked
function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes of all time. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the USA Today High School Player of the Year and led his team to a state championship.

He entered the NBA directly from high school, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 draft. LeBron quickly became known for his combination of size, athleticism, passing ability, and basketball IQ. He has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (two stints), the Miami Heat, and the Los Angeles Lakers, winning championships with each franchise (2007, 2012, 2013, 2016, 2020). His accolades include multiple NBA Most Valuable Player awards, All‑Star selections, and Olympic gold medals with Team USA.

Beyond the court, LeBron is also a philanthropist, entrepreneur, and media personality. He founded the LeBron James Family Foundation, which focuses on education initiatives such as the I PROMISE School in Akron. He has produced films and television shows through his company SpringHill Entertainment and has been involved in various business ventures, including a partnership with Nike and ownership stakes in sports teams and media outlets.
